question: Does frozen current-main behaviour contain enough reproducible, reachable and Scoreline-separated policy capacity to justify implementing one identity-safe Duskblade Shatter-to-heavy-Attack tempo relay for causal study?
competingOptions: authorise only the exact Shatter-to-heavy-Attack relay below for identity preflight
close this relay without implementation and continue to another evidence-backed structural mechanism inside issue #421
record an inconclusive result at the frozen cap

candidate.producer: One real Duskblade Shatter arms at most one relay charge after the triggering Attack has resolved.
candidate.consumer: The next reward-pool Attack with printed cost at least 2 consumes the charge only when the charge reduces its effective Energy cost by exactly 1.
candidate.payoff: Exactly 1 Energy saved; no damage, Ward, draw, healing, chip, rarity, offer, acquisition or policy-score change is part of this family.
candidate.scope: Duskblade only. A charge is capped at one, does not stack, survives only inside the current combat and does not consume when another effect has already reduced the eligible Attack to zero.
candidate.mechanisticJustification: Shatter already represents the Duskblade breaking facets into fuel, while a three-Energy turn makes printed-cost-2-or-3 reward Attacks the narrow consumer class. The relay therefore tests temporal conversion of the aspect's existing producer into a selective heavy-Attack repertoire rather than another Shatter scalar.
candidate.structuralSeparation: The producer/consumer grammar contains neither Chisel nor Faultline, does not read Scoreline, Ward, Afterimage or Kindle, and cannot fire for Ashwarden.
candidate.claimBoundary: A capacity pass authorises only research-knob implementation and null/mediator identity preflight. Existing-row co-occurrence is not temporal activation, complementarity, outcome benefit, content admission or product scope.

closedDirections: Shatterer's Crown offer, threshold and Fervor families
the immutable issue #524 static-exposure and old-label paths
the immutable issue #525 Cinder Cut and Kindle-damage ladders

sourceFilter.pool: The union of the frozen common, uncommon and rare reward card pools.
sourceFilter.selectionTiming: The rule and exact eligible set are frozen before reading their policy-capacity counts. No card may be added, removed or singled out after the result.

baseline.name: current-main root-551 Duskblade Vow-5 natural reward/economy rectangle

cohort.robustActive: At least two of the four frozen rows contain both at least one real Shatter and at least one played eligible heavy Attack.
cohort.robustInactive: None of the four frozen rows contains that co-occurrence.
cohort.ambiguous: Exactly one frozen row contains that co-occurrence; ambiguous identities count as neither active nor inactive.
cohort.scorelineCapacityProxy: At least two frozen rows play both Chisel and Faultline. This proxy is used only for a necessary non-alias screen; exact Scoreline causal admission remains owned by its prior held-out evidence.
cohort.viable: At least two of the four frozen current-main rows win.

gates.provenance: The 16 active/16 inactive and eight reachability/viability/separation minima reuse the frozen 64-policy first-look support scale. Requiring at least three consumed cards prevents a post-hoc one-card route, and the Jaccard ceiling rejects a near-alias of Scoreline.

decisionRules.success: Every frozen capacity, reachability, viability, source-breadth and Scoreline-separation gate passes.
decisionRules.successAuthority: Implement only the exact binary research relay and prove omitted/null path, RNG and result identity plus factor isolation before any causal row. Then preregister a CRN mediator-first experiment; this screen itself supports no causal or product claim.
decisionRules.futilityAuthority: Close the Shatter-to-heavy-Attack relay without implementation or simulator spend and continue with the next evidence-backed structural mechanism inside issue #421. Do not weaken, subset or retune this screen.
decisionRules.inconclusive: The deterministic screen reaches the frozen wall-time cap before a decision.
decisionRules.inconclusiveAuthority: Record the inconclusive result at the cap without implementation or simulator spend.
